people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

people.name: Gilgal
people.line: A significant site during Israel's early history in Canaan.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Mizpah
people.line: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment

translations.web: He went from year to year in a circuit to Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah; and he judged Israel in all those places.
translations.bsb: Every year he would go on a circuit from Bethel to Gilgal to Mizpah, judging Israel in all these places.
translations.kjv: And he went from year to year in circuit to Bethel, and Gilgal, and Mizpeh, and judged Israel in all those places.
translations.asv: And he went from year to year in circuit to Beth-el and Gilgal, and Mizpah; and he judged Israel in all those places.
